name: Kanban Tool
description_en:
Kanban Tool is a product in the Project management category. Its directory profile covers Timeline View, Project Templates, Idea Management, Custom Workflows, Kanban Board, Compliance Management, Recurring Task Management, Time & Expense Tracking.

Additional listed capabilities include Task Management, Status Tracking, Resource Management, Project Planning, Portfolio Management, Percent-Complete Tracking, Milestone Tracking, Issue Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $6.00. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: move work items through defined process stages; create, assign and track units of work; allocate people, time and other project resources; coordinate a group of related projects or investments; track significant project checkpoints; track reported issues and their resolution process. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Kanban Tool 属于项目管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括时间轴视图、项目模板、创意管理、自定义工作流、看板、合规管理、周期任务管理、工时与费用跟踪。

资料还列出任务管理、状态跟踪、资源管理、项目规划、项目组合管理、完成百分比跟踪、里程碑跟踪、问题管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $6.00. 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：让工作项在预设流程阶段间流转；创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；分配人员、时间和其他项目资源；统筹一组相关项目或投资；跟踪项目中的重要检查节点；跟踪已报告的问题及其解决过程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
